scan.title: Scan
scan.subtitle: Check fair prices or analyze contracts before signing.
scan.price_description: Select a comparable category or simulate a scenario to compare the amount against the community median in Valledupar.
scan.contract_description: Orientative plain-language clause review sample for lease or service agreements.
scan.contract_no_document_note: The points below are an educational sample case. OCR scanning and live document analysis will be enabled in VJ-13 and VJ-14.
scan.contract_legal_disclaimer: Orientative notice: this educational demonstration does not constitute professional legal advice.
scan.contract_capture_subtitle: Camera and file upload will be enabled in task VJ-13 without requesting permissions in this version.
scan.dialog_body: Visual OCR extraction (VJ-13) and Gemini document analysis (VJ-14) will be enabled in their respective phases. In Prices mode you can already test the DEMO semaphore engine.
scan.demo_note: UI demonstration: labeled sample data, does not capture real photos in this version.

price_verdict.demo_scenarios_subtitle: Tap a scenario to load sample zone values or select another zone and amount manually.
price_verdict.zone_field_helper: Reference medians vary according to the zone of {city} where you are located.
price_verdict.gps_prompt_banner: Allow your location to automatically detect your zone, or select it by tapping on the map.
price_verdict.map_tap_instruction: Tap any point or zone on the map to adjust the reference median.
price_verdict.gps_permission_dialog_body: Allow Vía Justa to use your phone's location to automatically detect your zone in {city}? If you prefer not to allow it, you can pick the zone on the map.
price_verdict.amount_error_invalid: Enter a valid amount in Colombian pesos greater than zero.
price_verdict.simulate_event_subtitle: Shows how the zone reference median is presented during the Vallenato Festival.
price_verdict.level_green_subtitle: The submitted amount is close to or below the median reported by the community in this zone.
price_verdict.level_yellow_subtitle: The amount exceeds the community median for this zone by 15% to 40%. Check what is included in the service.
price_verdict.level_red_subtitle: The amount exceeds the observed community median for this zone and category by more than 40%.
price_verdict.level_insufficient_title: Insufficient data in this zone and category
price_verdict.level_insufficient_subtitle: We do not yet have the minimum of 3 community reports in this zone required for a reliable semaphore verdict.
price_verdict.recommended_cap_label: Suggested orientative cap in this zone (+15% above median)
price_verdict.sample_size_label: Zone sample: N = {n} community reports (last {days} days)
price_verdict.insufficient_sample_detail: There are currently only N = {n} report(s) in this zone during the last 60 days (at least 3 are required).
price_verdict.insufficient_no_threshold: For statistical transparency, Vía Justa does not display semaphore colors or caps when the zone sample is insufficient.
price_verdict.low_price_warning_title: Notice: unusually low amount (more than 40% below zone median)
price_verdict.low_price_warning_body: Although below the cap, such a low charge may indicate an incomplete service, hidden fee, or different unit.
price_verdict.event_context_detail: Event reference (median) for this zone: {ref} ({dev} compared to submitted amount).
price_verdict.orientative_disclaimer: Orientative community statistical reference based on the selected zone median (not a legally binding official tariff nor AI advice).
price_verdict.contribute_from_result_cta: Contribute a price in this zone (DEMO)
price_verdict.empty_result_prompt: Select a zone, category, and amount on the scan screen to check the semaphore.
price_verdict.load_error: We couldn't evaluate the price right now.

price_contribute.step1_subtitle: Choose the exact category of the service or item you paid for to keep the sample comparable.
price_contribute.step2_subtitle: Enter the total amount you paid in Colombian pesos (whole numbers).
price_contribute.error_amount_empty: Enter the amount in Colombian pesos that you paid.
price_contribute.error_amount_invalid: Enter a valid positive whole number in COP.
price_contribute.error_amount_min: The minimum allowed amount for a report is $500 COP.
price_contribute.error_amount_max: The amount exceeds the maximum allowed ($20,000,000 COP).
price_contribute.note_privacy_helper: Optional (max 120 characters). For privacy, do not include personal names or private data.
price_contribute.step4_subtitle: Review your report details before saving it to the demo session.
price_contribute.demo_sync_disclaimer: Saved locally (DEMO); will sync when connection is active in VJ-10.

contract_capture.title: Local contract capture & OCR
contract_capture.subtitle: Take a photo, pick a file (JPG, PNG, or TXT up to 10 MB), try a synthetic sample, or edit the text before analysis.
contract_capture.formats_badge: MVP formats: JPG, PNG, TXT (max 10 MB)
contract_capture.samples_title: Synthetic test contracts (no real personal data)
contract_capture.samples_subtitle: Tap a synthetic case to load its extracted text in Spanish or English.
contract_capture.rn10_privacy_banner: RN-10 Privacy: the temporary file is deleted from cache immediately after OCR and the text only lives in memory until you discard it.
contract_capture.editor_hint: Paste or edit the contract clauses here (between 20 and 15,000 characters)...
contract_capture.error_unsupported_format: Unsupported format. Only JPG, PNG images or TXT files are accepted in the MVP.
contract_capture.error_pdf_coming_soon: PDF file support is coming soon. For now, please use photos (JPG/PNG) or text (TXT).
contract_capture.error_file_too_large: The file exceeds the maximum allowed size of 10 MB.
contract_capture.error_empty_or_illegible: The text is empty or illegible (at least 20 readable characters required).
contract_capture.error_exceeds_max_length: The text exceeds the 15,000-character limit ({count} current). Please trim at least {excess} characters in the editor; it is not truncated automatically.
contract_capture.error_read_failed: We couldn't read the document. Try another image or file.
